semantics.how: Stores responses keyed by input hash, prompt revision, provider and model, plus Pass A unit rows and a call log
semantics.what: Content-addressed SQLite cache for interpreter calls
semantics.why: Makes repeated runs idempotent and cheap

semantics.when: Called at the end of a run

semantics.how: Opens the SQLite file, creates the tables and indexes and runs the one-shot cleanup
semantics.what: Opens or creates the cache database
semantics.why: Prepares the schema once per process

semantics.how: Deletes the row for the key
semantics.when: Called when a cached response fails validation
semantics.why: A poisoned row cannot be served forever

semantics.how: Selects the response row for the key and returns the text and usage, or undefined
semantics.what: Looks up a cached provider result
semantics.when: Called by CachedProvider before calling the provider
semantics.why: Avoids repeat provider calls for identical prompts

semantics.how: Selects rows by key and filters to the unit id and current struct hash pairs, parsing each result
semantics.what: Returns cached Pass A results for units whose struct hash still matches
semantics.why: Matching both fields stops stale semantics resurrecting for edited code

semantics.how: Selects all call log rows in insertion order and maps them to records
semantics.when: Used by observability tooling and tests
semantics.why: Exposes the call log for analysis

semantics.how: Inserts a row with pass, unit, timing, tokens and cache status
semantics.what: Records one LLM call or cache hit

semantics.how: Checks a durable marker, scans rows once, deletes malformed ones and sets the marker
semantics.what: Deletes response rows that are not parseable JSON
semantics.why: Repairs damage from older behaviour without rescanning on every run

semantics.how: Upserts the response row for the key
semantics.when: Called by CachedProvider after a validated call

semantics.how: Upserts the row for the key, unit id and struct hash
semantics.what: Records one unit's Pass A outcome durably
semantics.why: A crash mid-run keeps finished work

semantics.what: Parses JSON, returning undefined on failure
semantics.why: A corrupt row is discarded rather than aborting a lookup
